en.text: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 「人献供物为平安祭，若是从牛群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的献在耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 「人獻供物為平安祭，若是從牛群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的獻在耶和華面前。

en.text: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 他要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕门口。亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血洒在坛的周围。

zhTraditional.text: 他要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕門口。亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把血灑在壇的周圍。

en.text: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

zhSimplified.text: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，也要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，

zhTraditional.text: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，也要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，

en.text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

zhSimplified.text: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。

zhTraditional.text: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。

en.text: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦的子孙要把这些烧在坛的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫的子孫要把這些燒在壇的燔祭上，就是在火的柴上，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。

en.text: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

zhSimplified.text: 「人向耶和华献供物为平安祭，若是从羊群中献，无论是公的是母的，必用没有残疾的。

zhTraditional.text: 「人向耶和華獻供物為平安祭，若是從羊群中獻，無論是公的是母的，必用沒有殘疾的。

en.text: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;

zhSimplified.text: 若献一只羊羔为供物，必在耶和华面前献上，

zhTraditional.text: 若獻一隻羊羔為供物，必在耶和華面前獻上，

en.text: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 并要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围。

zhTraditional.text: 並要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍。

en.text: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

zhSimplified.text: 从平安祭中，将火祭献给耶和华，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨处取下，并要把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，

zhTraditional.text: 從平安祭中，將火祭獻給耶和華，其中的脂油和整肥尾巴都要在靠近脊骨處取下，並要把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，

en.text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

zhSimplified.text: 两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下。

zhTraditional.text: 兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下。

en.text: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，是献给耶和华为食物的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，是獻給耶和華為食物的火祭。

en.text: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和华面前献上。

zhTraditional.text: 「人的供物若是山羊，必在耶和華面前獻上。

en.text: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 要按手在山羊头上，宰于会幕前。亚伦的子孙要把血洒在坛的周围，

zhTraditional.text: 要按手在山羊頭上，宰於會幕前。亞倫的子孫要把血灑在壇的周圍，

en.text: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

zhSimplified.text: 又把盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，并肝上的网子和腰子，一概取下，献给耶和华为火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又把蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，並肝上的網子和腰子，一概取下，獻給耶和華為火祭。

en.text: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.
The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要在坛上焚烧，作为馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和华的。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要在壇上焚燒，作為馨香火祭的食物。脂油都是耶和華的。

en.text: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

zhSimplified.text: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要成为你们世世代代永远的定例。」

zhTraditional.text: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可吃；這要成為你們世世代代永遠的定例。」
